title: Lead Thumbnail Designer
description:
LEAD THUMBNAIL DESIGNER | REMOTE

To Apply:

ROLE:

As the Lead Thumbnail Designer at Knwn Local, you'll build and develop a team of 5-10+ thumbnail designers who create scroll-stopping visuals that drive channel growth for America's top real estate leaders. This is a player-coach leadership role where you'll spend 60-80% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 20-40% hands-on designing complex projects.

You'll own design quality standards, team development, and creative operations across the agency, partnering closely with Pod Managers, Creative Director, and leadership on strategic initiatives. Your success is measured not by how many thumbnails you design, but by how well your team performs, grows, and delivers results that drive client success.

This role is perfect for someone who loves developing designers as much as designing itself - someone who gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands-on without management responsibilities, this isn't the right fit.

Apply now:

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership & Development (50-70% of role)

  • Directly manage 5-8 thumbnail designers conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill development and performance
  • Lead bi-weekly team design reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new designer hires
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for design team members
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework
  • Handle hiring (writing JDs, screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making offers)
  • Build 2-5+ year relationships with designers through proactive retention and engagement strategies
  • Conduct skip-level meetings with junior designers to assess team health and identify early warning signs

Creative Excellence & Standards (20-30% of role)

  • Design 15-30 high-impact thumbnails per month for VIP clients and complex projects
  • Own and evolve agency-wide creative quality standards, brand guidelines, and style guides
  • Establish QA processes that maintain 90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and performance analysis across the entire client portfolio
  • Serve as final creative approval for all thumbnails before client delivery
  • Drive creative innovation through monthly experimentation initiatives and "Good Flops"
  • Create and maintain design team's template library and asset management systems

Strategic Collaboration & Systems (10-20% of role)

  • Partner with Pod Managers on client strategy and creative direction for key accounts
  • Present creative strategy and performance insights in Monthly Client Strategy Calls with clients
  • Collaborate with executive leadership on agency-wide creative vision and initiatives
  • Build scalable workflows, capacity planning, and resource allocation systems
  • Create performance dashboards tracking team metrics (CTR, approval rates, turnaround times)
  • Document best practices, SOPs, and knowledge base for the design function
  • Contribute to quarterly planning, annual strategy summits, and company OKRs

REQUIREMENTS:

Leadership & Design Experience

  • 6+ years of professional design experience with 2+ years managing creative teams
  • Proven track record leading, developing, and scaling design teams of 5+ people
  • Minimum 3+ years creating high-performing YouTube thumbnails with proven CTR results
  • Experience hiring designers, conducting performance reviews, and managing accountability
  • Portfolio showcasing thumbnails that contributed to channel growth (include CTR data)
  • Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, firing, conflict resolution)

Technical & Strategic Skills

  • Expert-level proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma (portfolio required)
  • Deep understanding of YouTube algorithms, CTR optimization, and viewer psychology
  • Data-driven approach with ability to interpret analytics and translate into design strategy
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies, performance analysis, and optimization
  • Strong presentation skills for client-facing strategy calls and executive meetings
  • Understanding of creative team economics (capacity planning, resourcing, budgeting)

Communication & Cultural Leadership

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and documentation
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • Extreme Ownership - Takes full accountability for team results; never blames or makes excuses
  • Beyond Excellence - Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity - Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of needs
  • Mission Focus - Obsesses about client success and team development over personal recognition

RESULTS:

Team Performance

  • Your design team consistently maintains 90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Designer retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New designers productive at 80% capacity within 30-60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter
  • Team operates at 80-90% capacity utilization - productive output without burnout

Quality & Impact

  • Zero client escalations due to design quality issues or missed deadlines from your team
  • Agency-wide thumbnail CTR averages 5-10% (significantly above platform benchmarks)
  • 95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio
  • Design workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide
  • Your team generates innovative thumbnail strategies that drive agency-wide adoption

Strategic Leadership

  • Design function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership
  • Successfully contribute to client strategy with design insights that drive performance
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for design quality and communication
  • At least 1-2 designers promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship
  • Leadership views design as a strategic differentiator, not just an execution function

COMPENSATION & GROWTH:

Salary & Benefits

  • Starting Range: $##,000 - $##,000 USD/year depending on experience and team size managed
  • Medical, Vision, Dental Benefits (employer-subsidized, starts after 60-90 day trial)
  • Flexible PTO policy, professional development budget, home office stipend
  • Leadership development program, quarterly team offsites, and annual strategy summit

Growth Path

  • Current Role: Lead Thumbnail Designer (managing 5-8 designers, 60-70% leadership)
  • Next Step (18-24 months): Creative Director (full design function, brand, all creative output)
  • Future Opportunity (36-48 months): VP of Creative or functional leadership with P&L ownership

Performance Metrics You'll Own

  • Team Performance: Design Quality Score, First-Approval Rate (90%+), CTR performance
  • Team Development: Skill progression, promotion readiness, retention rate (85%+)
  • Operational Excellence: Capacity utilization (80-90%), on-time delivery (95%+)

LOCATION:

WHO WE ARE:

Knwn Local helps America's top real estate leaders (ranked by Wall Street Journal Real Trends) attract more clients and grow their brands through strategic YouTube presence. Our clients manage $30M-$300M+ real estate teams and brokerages.

We're scaling from 55+ to 200+ channels with the mission of helping agents dominate their local markets through long-form video content that builds trust and authority.

Our Core Values: Extreme Ownership, Beyond Excellence, Proactive Curiosity, Mission Focus

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

description:
Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.

Esperamos que você tenha:

Card Authority and Disputes Administrator

Join to apply for the Card Authority and Disputes Administrator role at Paymentology .

At Paymentology , we’re redefining what’s possible in the payments space. As the first truly global issuer‑processor, we give banks and fintechs the technology and talent to launch and manage Mastercard and Visa cards at scale across more than 60 countries. Our advanced, multi‑cloud platform delivers real‑time data, unmatched scalability, and the flexibility of shared or dedicated processing instances. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

We’re looking for a Card Authority and Disputes Administrator to manage and process chargebacks, transaction disputes, and card authority operations across global card networks. This role ensures every case and authorisation exception is validated, documented, and resolved in line with regulatory and card scheme standards. You’ll play a key role in protecting clients and cardholders from financial loss while upholding Paymentology’s operational integrity, operating independently on assigned cases and prioritising workload against SLA and regulatory deadlines.

Responsibilities

  • Handle and process cardholder disputes involving authorised and unauthorised transactions.
  • Conduct detailed investigations using multiple internal systems and external partners.
  • Validate data accuracy and ensure all documentation meets compliance and network standards.
  • Determine appropriate actions and craft timely, accurate responses to networks within SLA and regulatory timelines.
  • Oversee card authority processes including transaction approvals, declines, and authorisation reviews.
  • Provide guidance to internal teams and clients on dispute outcomes, escalations, and card authorisation queries.
  • Maintain current knowledge of card scheme rules, dispute categories, and operational procedures.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in dispute resolution, authorisation processes, and reporting accuracy.

Requirements

  • Strong understanding of Visa/Mastercard dispute and card authorisation processes and compliance standards.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word) and case management tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Analytical, customer‑centric, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to work to tight deadlines.
  • Able to coordinate with card network partners, client operations teams, and internal reconciliation staff to ensure compliance and customer satisfaction.
  • 2–4 years in dispute resolution, card operations, or financial customer service.

What You Can Look Forward To

At Paymentology , it’s not just about building great payment technology, it’s about building a company where people feel they belong and their work matters. You’ll be part of a diverse, global team that’s genuinely committed to making a positive impact through what we do. Whether you’re working across time zones or getting involved in initiatives that support local communities, you’ll find real purpose in your work and the freedom to grow in a supportive, forward‑thinking environment.

title: Test Architect
description:
Senior Software Test Designer

At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high‑tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?

TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting‑edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real‑world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth.

What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.

Your responsibilities

  • Oversee the entire testing architecture/strategies, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing.
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and develop tools for qualification and integration.
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best results.
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment.
  • Review code and mentor junior engineers.
  • Share expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes.
  • Act as an advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspire others to strive for quality.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Challenging and interesting projects in different domains.
  • Benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues.
  • Focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions.
  • Annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy.
  • Tech events and knowledge sessions.

This will make you better:

  • Contract for an indefinite period of time.
  • An all‑in employee benefit package (€61,000 – €85,000 annually): inclusive of competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance.
  • Good secondary employment conditions: e.g., 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme, relocation budget.

This will keep you healthy:

  • A good work‑life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working.
  • An inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym.
  • The home office support package will turn your 'home office' into an inspiring environment.
  • Lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.

What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar.
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high‑tech domain.
  • Capability to define and oversee the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution.
  • Background in software development/automation and experience with object‑oriented programming and developing test frameworks for complex embedded systems.
  • Preferably experience with end‑to‑end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining the ROBOT test framework.
  • Proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher‑level testing (system integration, component testing), and familiarity with methods such as BDD, keyword‑driven testing, data‑driven testing, model‑based testing, and property‑based testing.
  • Team player, solution‑oriented, and proactive.
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills.
  • Good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high‑tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge‑to‑cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low‑level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System‑on‑Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

description:
About Us:
At edclub, we are committed to revolutionizing the way K-12 students learn through engaging and interactive educational content. We create comprehensive, high-quality courses that inspire curiosity and facilitate deep learning. We're seeking a talented Designer to join our dynamic team to help bring educational content to life with creativity and purpose.

Job Description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to join our team. In this role, you will design educational materials that enhance learning experiences for students. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of user experience principles and a passion for creating intuitive, visually appealing digital products. You will collaborate with project managers, developers, and content creators to produce visually engaging and interactive educational tools.

This role will be fully remote, as our headquarters are located in Rockville, Maryland, USA.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Create graphics, illustrations, and visual elements for experiences that align with educational objectives.
  2. Work closely with curriculum and content teams to ensure design elements support educational goals.
  3. Ensure a consistent visual style that is age-appropriate and accessible to diverse audiences.
  4. Collaborate with the team to brainstorm creative ideas and solutions for presenting content in innovative ways.
  5. Create engaging animations and motion graphics to enhance student learning and understanding.
  6. Stay up-to-date with design trends, animation techniques, and educational tools to continuously improve content quality.

Qualifications:

  1. 3-5 years of proven experience in graphic and UI/UX design.
  2. Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Illustrator; experience with animation tools like After Effects, Blender, or similar.
  3. Strong portfolio showcasing a range of design and animation work.
  4. Understanding of visual storytelling, typography, and layout principles.
  5. Knowledge of user-centered design principles and how students of different age groups engage with content.
  6. Communicate effectively in English with team members.
  7. Collaborative attitude with a willingness to accept feedback and adapt designs accordingly.
  8. Ability to think creatively and bring innovative ideas to enhance student engagement.

The Senior Telecom Manager is responsible for managing the Telecom Infrastructure planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil.   • Good Procurement and contract management skills

  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence

  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)

description:
ANBIMA Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Descrição da vaga

Nós movemos o mercado financeiro para o futuro, impulsionando negócios e potencializar a economia do país. Com o maior hub de dados e informações do cenário financeiro brasileiro, lideramos iniciativas que realmente importam: defendemos os interesses dos nossos parceiros e investidores, fornecemos ferramentas analíticas e dados, educamos investidores e certificamos profissionais, além de estabelecermos regras para as instituições do mercado financeiro e de capitais.

Como Analista de Cibersegurança Sênior para integrar nosso time e atuar na proteção, monitoramento e evolução da segurança da informação em ambientes críticos. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem experiência sólida em segurança e deseja trabalhar com práticas modernas como DevSecOps , essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Implementar e manter políticas e controles de segurança em ambientes corporativos;
  • Realizar análise de vulnerabilidades e propor medidas corretivas;
  • Atuar na integração de práticas DevSecOps em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Monitorar incidentes e responder a eventos de segurança;
  • Prestar apoio técnico em segurança para equipes internas e projetos;
  • Emitir pareceres de segurança sobre soluções, arquiteturas e mudanças propostas;
  • Implementar ferramentas de segurança, garantindo sua correta configuração e integração;
  • Conduzir projetos de segurança, desde o planejamento até a execução, alinhando com as áreas envolvidas;
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e operações para garantir segurança desde a concepção até a entrega;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e recomendações estratégicas para gestão de riscos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação - Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou cursos correlatos.
  • Sólida atuação em Cibersegurança corporativa.
  • Experiência prática em DevSecOps (integração de segurança em CI/CD, automação de testes de segurança).
  • Experiência com análise de logs e alertas de SIEM.
  • Controles de segurança em nuvem (AWS preferencialmente).
  • Ferramentas de segurança: scanners de vulnerabilidade (Nessus, Qualys), ferramentas de SAST/DAST (SonarQube, OWASP ZAP), etc.
  • Processos DevSecOps : automação de testes de segurança, integração contínua com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, e uso de pipelines seguros.
  • Linguagens para automação (Python, Shell) e scripts para integração.

Soft Skills

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas.
  • Perfil analítico e foco em resultados.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, ou equivalentes.
  • Certificação relacionada a DevSecOps será um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

  • Vale Refeição R$ 1.177,00;
  • Vale Alimentação R$ 925,00;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;

  • Auxílio Home Office;

Local de trabalho: Nosso escritório fica na região do centro do Rio de Janeiro. Estamos trabalhando de forma hibrida, escritório (3x por semana) e home-office (2x por semana).

Quem somos

Muito prazer, somos a ANBIMA – Associação Brasileira das Entidades dos Mercados Financeiro e de Capitais. Falamos em nome de instituições como bancos, gestoras, corretoras, distribuidoras e administradoras. Temos a missão de fortalecer a representação do setor e apoiar a evolução de um mercado de capitais capaz de financiar o desenvolvimento econômico e social do Brasil e influenciar o mercado global.

Somos protagonistas da evolução da indústria de investimentos, trazendo impacto e legado positivos ao nosso país. Se você tem sede de aprender a impactar o desenvolvimento econômico e social do Brasil, a ANBIMA é para você!

title: Pessoa Analista de Infraestrutura Júnior (Field)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Prazer, Grupo SBF. Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil; da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado, o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerenciar e dar suporte à infraestrutura tecnológica das lojas (servidores de loja, estações de PDV, impressoras fiscais/não fiscais, leitores de código de barras e pin pads).
  • Atuar em incidentes de nível 2 e 3 que impactem a operação de vendas e o atendimento ao cliente, garantindo o rápido restabelecimento dos serviços.
  • Coordenar a manutenção corretiva e preventiva de equipamentos de TI nas unidades, interagindo com fornecedores e técnicos de campo.
  • Realizar configurações e atualizações de firmware e software específicos do ambiente de loja.
  • Administrar a rede local (LAN) das lojas, incluindo switches, access points Wi‑Fi e links de comunicação (WAN).

    • Be an integral part of the wider Americas Region commercial team – this is not a role for a lone wolf.

    • Minimum Bachelors degree in engineering or business
    • Be the tenacious hunter.
    • Extrovert, happy to present to both small client groups but also to large audiences.
    • Proactively build and maintain strong relationships, both externally and internally.
    • Have worked in a multi-cultural commercial environment.
    • Courage to make qualified independent decisions and move forward.
    • Solution oriented and highly proactive.
    • Collaborative, both within immediate team and the wider business.
    • Excellent communication skills and ability to inspire people, building strong relationships.
    • Ability to travel to where the customer is – primarily within LATAM.
    • Fluent in English & Portuguese, both spoken and written.

    Preferable;

    • Experience in Renewables and/or offshore energy industries within the LATAM market.
    • A professional network within the offshore and / or wind sector; this may be from a substructure design / developer / OEM / software domain.
    • Commercial experience within the technical software sector.
    • Fluent in Spanish, both spoken and written.
    • MBA degree

    Company & Business Area Description

    DNV is the independent expert in assurance and risk management, operating in more than 100 countries. Through our broad experience and deep expertise we advance safety and sustainable performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions.

    We are a world-leading provider of digital solutions and software applications with focus on the energy, maritime and healthcare markets. Our solutions are used worldwide to manage risk and performance for wind turbines, electric grids, pipelines, processing plants, offshore structures, ships, and more. Supported by our domain knowledge and Veracity assurance platform, we enable companies to digitize and manage business critical activities in a sustainable, cost-efficient, safe and secure way.

    Product Line Renewables & Ocean Structures builds and distributes engineering software. Our mission is to “empower the world’s professionals to accelerate the energy transition, and sustainable use of the ocean”, and we aim “to be the most trusted engineering and digitalization partner, bringing value through our customer experience focus”. Our portfolio of software products includes a combination of successful industry favorites like Sesam, Bladed, and Nauticus Machinery, and new products aiming for hypergrowth WindFarmer and SolarFarmer.

    Our Product Line is part of the DNV – Digital Solutions business area, built up of functional teams across a collaborative organization structure. The Renewables & Ocean Structures product line includes a product center where software is developed, a product management team, sales regions and a marketing and communications team.

    This Senior Business Development role will report to the Head of Business Development, Americas Region as part of the commercial management team.

    The Senior Business Development Manager will have responsibility for leading DNV’s client facing strategy within the LATAM market, with the key focus on Brazil, to roll out a multi-year roadmap for the expansion of our market footprint within country.

    The key focus of this role is to develop DNV Digital Solutions penetration and market position within the LATAM market, the primary focus of which will be offshore wind. The Senior Business Development Manager will lead by example and build strong relationships, both internally with the wider regional commercial team, along with global functions, including the Product Line & Product Center, MarCom, Legal and Finance as well as interaction with clients at a senior, decision-maker level.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Be among the first 25 applicants. We are looking for the right people—people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You'll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end—from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high‑quality software—and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non‑functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium‑sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on‑time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in‑person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade‑offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid‑level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post‑mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event‑driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands‑on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Consultor de Vendas - Rio de Janeiro/RJ - Barra da Tijuca

Sobre nós
Somos orgulhosamente brasileiros e populares, digitais sempre e presenciais quando o cliente quiser. Inovamos para dar acesso a serviços financeiros e oferecemos uma experiência que encoraja as pessoas a vencerem o hoje. Nossa razão de existir é clara: lutar por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros. E fazemos isso com disponibilidade, acolhimento e agilidade.

Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi

Viver pelo cliente
Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado.

Agir como empreendedor
Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Crescer na jornada
Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.

Seus desafios para crescer na jornada

  • Dominar o portfólio de produtos do Agibank.
  • Prospectar novos clientes através de ações externas, telemarketing ativo, atendimento via mídias sociais, indicações, parcerias, conversão de oportunidades, conversão de leads gerados e atendimento presencial em loja.
  • Efetuar a venda consultiva dos produtos e serviços do Agibank com eficiência e conduzir as negociações de forma flexível e orientada a resultados.
  • Apresentar ao cliente os canais digitais do Agibank, incentivando e auxiliando no seu uso.
  • Prestar um bom atendimento conforme o método de atendimento e vendas do Agibank com o intuito de construir uma relação de confiança e respeito com o cliente.
  • Manter a carteira de clientes com dados atualizados e registrados.
  • Validar oportunidades, registrar em sistema e ser responsável por todo andamento e qualidade da carteira, retendo o cliente e revertendo possíveis perdas.
  • Identificar e solucionar possíveis problemas relacionados a contratos.

O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado?

Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Conhecimento básico do pacote Office
  • Certificação de Correspondente Bancário para ofertar produtos de Crédito Consignado (FEBRABAN, ANEPS, entre outras), indispensável pra o exercício da atividade.

Diferenciais

  • Ensino superior em andamento
  • Formação em CPA10
  • Experiência em vendas e prospecção de clientes através de vendas digitais e ativas

Benefícios e facilidades

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, vale-refeição e alimentação e seguro de vida/auxílio-funeral.
  • Maternidade e paternidade: auxílio‑creche, licença‑maternidade de 6 meses, licença‑paternidade de 20 dias, VA/VR no período da licença.
  • Previdência privada
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente.
  • Vale‑transporte
  • Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário.
  • Dinheiro de volta no Cartão de Crédito: 1% de cashback sobre o valor total da fatura do cartão revertido em crédito na fatura seguinte.
  • Conta remunerada: CDB de aplicação automática e rendimento de 100% do CDI.
  • Isenção de Tarifas de Comunicação Digital.
  • Crédito do Trabalhador: taxa e prazo diferenciados. Disponível para contratação a partir de 6 meses de casa.
  • Antecipação Saque aniversário do FGTS.
  • Dr. Pet: possibilidade fazer plano de saúde para pets com até 20% de desconto.

Programa Tô de dono
O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce. Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. Aqui, a fórmula é simples: você cresce. O Agibank cresce com você.

description:
Descrição

Análise de Requisições de Compra: Receber e analisar as requisições de pequena, média e alta complexidades, verificando sua conformidade com as Normas e Procedimentos internos;

Aquisição de bens e contratação de serviços: Adquirir bens e serviços de pequena, média e alta complexidades (relação valor versus risco para a empresa), orientando as áreas na elaboração do projeto básico (Termo de Referência, RFI, RFP, RFQ) e cadastros no sistema;

Nota técnica: Orientar as áreas na elaboração de nota técnica de diretoria, sempre que a demanda não estiver enquadrada à norma de compras vigente;

Banco e avaliação de fornecedores: Pesquisar e cadastrar fornecedores elegíveis à contratação para aquisição de materiais, bens e serviços, através das ferramentas administrativas (consultas às áreas demandantes, internet, revistas especializadas, cadastro de fornecedores, ações de benchmarking, etc.);

Negociação – Redução de custo nas aquisições de bens e contratações de serviços (Saving) – Processos Novos e Aditivos: Analisar os contratos vigentes e as condições comerciais apresentadas nos orçamentos recebidos;

Registro dos processos de Compras: Garantir a manutenção do histórico dos processos de compras, para acompanhamento, controle e melhor subsidiar os processos de auditorias e geração de dados para os Indicadores de Compras;

Indicadores de Desempenho de Compras: acompanhamento e a análise dos resultados da área através de gráficos e relatórios analíticos para subsidiar propostas de melhorias;

Atendimento à Auditoria: Apoiar o atendimento à auditoria, levantando documentos e esclarecendo dúvidas sobre os processos de compras;

Melhorias de Processos: Subsidiar a gerência nas melhorias de processos pertinentes a aquisições de bens e contrações de serviços, incluindo testes para cumprimento dos protocolos sistêmicos e validação dos processos de compras;

Atividades de contingência: Sempre que necessário, em contingência na área, ajudar a equipe na realização de processos, visando agilidade e/ou cumprimento de prazos para o melhor atendimento às demandas.

Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Administração ou correlatas;
  • Vivência sólida na função, na aquisição de bens e contratação de serviços em diversos segmentos, de pequena, média e alta complexidades, considerando valor e/ou risco do bem/serviços;
  • Domínio do sistema ERP (SAP), preferencialmente o módulo MM (solicitação de Cotação, Pedido de Compra, alteração de contratos);
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de negociação;
  • Prática na elaboração de RFI¹ (Request for RFP² (Request for Proposal) e RFQ³ (Request for Quotation);
  • Mandatório conhecimentos em Excel (nível intermediário a avançado), Word, Power Point. Serão exigidas análises e elaborações de relatórios, pareceres e apresentações utilizando essas ferramentas;
  • Experiência na análise das propostas, elaboração de pareceres das cotações, elaboração de apresentações dos processos e da área de Compras;
  • Conhecimento de Indicadores de Compras (KPIs).

Extras

  • CLT, formato híbrido;
  • Segunda a sexta-feira, de 9h às 18h;
  • Bairro: Centro - RJ.

Outros Requisitos

  • Facilidade na leitura de normas, políticas e Procedimentos;
  • Fluência verbal e escrita;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Visão holística.

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
Procurement Coordinator

Department: Finance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Procurement Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 will support the implementation of the FIFA27 Procurement Policy, ensuring organization-wide compliance through ongoing employee training and adherence checks. You will be responsible for the creation of Purchase Orders (POs) in SAP as well as other administrative matters. You will support project leaders with RFI/RFP processes. This role drives inter-departmental alignment and manages the FIFA27 SAP cost contract database to deliver cost efficiency, compliant, simple and transparent solutions across FIFA procurement landscape.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement the FIFA27 Procurement Policy and procedures across the organization. Act as gatekeeper of the process at the relevant stages.
  • Train employees on an on-going basis to ensure adherence to FIFA27 Procurement Policy.
  • Responsible for the SAP cost contract database, including entering and maintaining contract data and creation of Purchase Orders (POs).
  • Manage (solve or forward) queries raised to the FIFA27 Procurement team mailbox.
  • Support project leaders in all matters regarding procurement including tasks such as setting up RFIs and RFPs.
  • Create spend reports for management as requested.
  • Conduct administrative activities of the procurement team.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Terciary education in Business Administration, Procurement and/or extensive experience in indirect procurement.
  • Minimum 1 year experience in a similar role.
  • Good SAP MM knowledge is an asset.
  • Knowledge of DocuSign is an asset.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow is an asset
  • High standard of attention to detail.
  • Practical mindset. Solution oriented.
  • Capable of working in an environment of rapid change, tight deadlines and high scrutiny.
  • Understands the application of governance and compliance.
  • Understands key contract elements and contractual language.
  • Tolerance to repetitive work.
  • Organized, able to prioritize workloads.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Sobre a ACSC

title: Especialista de Planejamento e Orçamento de Obras
description:
Especialista de Planejamento e Orçamento de Obras

Um aeroporto com a alma carioca! O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do estado. Ao longo de 10 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

Aqui somos contagiados pelo Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser, onde nossos Integrantes atuam com garra e determinação para alcançar resultados, são incentivados a buscar o autodesenvolvimento , sendo agentes do próprio destino profissional, trabalham em equipe com colaboração e empatia e são norteados por um espírito de dono , cuidando e perseguindo sempre os melhores resultados.

Nosso Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser abraça a diversidade, por isso, nossos processos seletivos são abertos à todos, afinal trabalhamos todos os dias para a verdadeira conexão.

Se você se identifica com esses valores e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e que adora desafios, temos uma oportunidade como Especialista de Planejamento e Orçamento de Obras . Neste desafio, você atuará como referência técnica na elaboração, análise e controle de orçamentos e cronogramas de projetos de investimento (CAPEX) do aeroporto, garantindo robustez nas estimativas de custo, aderência às premissas de projeto, previsibilidade de riscos e clareza na comunicação para tomada de decisão executiva.

Responsabilidades

  • Elaborar orçamentos detalhados de obras e serviços de engenharia, com base em cadernos de referência e demais bases oficiais;
  • Realizar cotações de mercado para itens específicos, especializados ou não padronizados;
  • Consolidar estimativas de custo considerando escopo, premissas técnicas, faseamento executivo e interfaces operacionais do aeroporto;
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de projetos para:
  • Avaliar e validar premissas de orçamentação e planejamento;
  • Analisar soluções técnicas sob a ótica de custo, prazo e risco;
  • Apoiar decisões de alternativas técnicas e construtivas.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar o faseamento físico-financeiro dos projetos;
  • Identificar, analisar e quantificar riscos de custo e prazo, prevendo possíveis desvios e contingências;
  • Preparar análises críticas de variações (desvios) de orçamento e cronograma ao longo do ciclo do projeto;
  • Desenvolver apresentações executivas para defesa de desvios e impactos financeiros;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com escritório externo de projetos/orçamentos, garantindo alinhamento técnico e metodológico, qualidade das entregas e cumprimento de prazos, com postura de liderança técnica;
  • Apoiar processos de governança de CAPEX, auditorias técnicas e revisões internas;
  • Conhecimento em Planejamento físico-financeiro e gestão de riscos de custos e prazo.

Habilidades e qualificações necessárias

  • Formação em Engenharia Civil ou Engenharia de Produção;
  • Experiência comprovada em Orçamentos de obras de infraestrutura e edificações e análise de CAPEX para empreendimentos complexos;
  • Excel Avançado: Modelagem de planilhas orçamentárias, análise de cenários, curvas físicas e financeiras, uso de funções avançadas e tabela dinâmica;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Conhecimento da Metodologia Ágil;
  • Utilização de Ferramenta de Organização;
  • Pacote Office Avançado;
  • Boa comunicação, tanto para escrita quanto para fala;
  • Visão analítica;
  • Possuir as Atitudes GATE do Integrante RIOgaleão: Garra e Determinação, Autodesenvolvimento, Trabalho em Equipe e Espírito de Dono.

Você sai na frente se

  • Pós-graduação e/ou cursos de especialização;
  • Conhecimento regulatório: familiaridade com as regulamentações aplicáveis ao setor aeroportuário (ANAC, Infraero, etc.) e normas de acessibilidade, segurança e qualidade;
  • Experiência anterior em concessionárias de prestação de serviços, aeroportos, shoppings, hospitais e/ou áreas de atendimento ao público com operação pulsante.

Benefícios

Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Inaugurada em 2012 a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais nas 24 horas do dia, todos os dias da semana, inclusive sábados, domingos e feriados.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

  • Preparar fórmulas de composições lácteas, hídricas e dietas enterais a serem utilizadas nas diversas áreas, bem como efetuar a higienização de embalagens, bicos, mamadeiras e outros;
  • Preparar fórmulas lácteas enterais, dentro das especificações predeterminadas pelos Nutricionistas;

  • Preparar, identificar, envasar e distribuir fórmulas lácteas e enterais;
  • Preparar sopas, papas sucos de frutas, efetuando a distribuição de acordo com a divisão em porções adequadas, considerando para a distribuição a identificação antecipada de cada paciente que receberá o alimento;
  • Utilizar técnicas dietéticas de preparo de alimentos;

  • Coletar amostras das preparações confeccionadas no Lactário, seguindo técnicas padrão de coletas para controle microbiológico das mesmas;
  • Verificar a temperatura ambiente diária e a temperatura dos equipamentos de refrigeração instalados no Lactário, evitando que uma eventual variação brusca na temperatura do ambiente ou do equipamento possa alterar a composição dos alimentos estocados;

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

We’re looking for someone who can design realistic and structured evaluation scenarios for LLM‑based agents. You’ll create test cases that simulate human‑performed tasks and define gold‑standard behavior to compare agent actions against. You’ll work to ensure each scenario is clearly defined, well‑scored, and easy to execute and reuse. You’ll need a sharp analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in how AI agents make decisions.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design structured test scenarios based on real‑world tasks
  • Define the golden path and acceptable agent behavior
  • Annotate task steps, expected outputs, and edge cases
  • Work with devs to test your scenarios and improve clarity
  • Review agent outputs and adapt tests accordingly

  • Freelance role is fully remote; you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available, and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

Nice to Have

  • Experience in writing manual or automated test cases

description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

Type of role

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well‑suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases. You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviours (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: what’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, “what could go wrong”)
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Seniority level

Employment type

  • Part‑time

Job function

Industries

Preferred Qualifications

title: Mix-media Video Editor
description:
Mix-media Video Editor (Video + Motion)


We are hiring a video editor who can own end-to-end content delivery across short‑form video, mixed media and motion‑driven social assets. This role is built for someone who lives in modern social feeds, understands what earns attention today, and can turn a simple script, reference, or raw footage into a finished piece that performs.


You will edit fast and bring daily creative momentum to Darkroom’s brand. While occasional longer edits still matter, the core of your work will be short‑form social content, performance‑minded cutdowns, and motion‑enhanced storytelling.


You will also help define how Darkroom shows up across platforms through consistent, high‑quality video output.


This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST zone. Candidates based in Portugal, Spain, and Brazil are encouraged to apply.


What You Will Do


Short‑form and social‑first editing



  • Edit and produce high‑volume, high‑quality short‑form content for Darkroom across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and X.

  • Build “thumb‑stopping” edits that land quickly, hold attention, and deliver one clear takeaway.

  • Pull the strongest moments from raw footage, podcasts, webinars, events and internal shoots, then shape them into tight narratives.

  • Create platform‑specific versions of the same concept, including aspect ratio variations and multiple hooks for testing.

  • Deliver A and B variants to support creative learning and performance optimization.


Mixed media and motion design



  • Design and animate motion elements that elevate social edits, including kinetic typography, graphic transitions, and lightweight compositing.

  • Build mixed media layouts that combine video, stills, screen recordings, overlays, and design assets into one cohesive piece.

  • Develop reusable motion templates that speed up production without sacrificing quality.

  • Maintain strong design taste so motion and visuals align with Darkroom branding.


End‑to‑end ownership



  • Take a reference, script, brief, or rough direction and run with it independently.

  • Manage projects from first cut to final export, including file organization and archiving for future reuse.

  • Collaborate with marketing, strategy, and creative leadership, while staying comfortable making calls when direction is loose.

  • Anticipate bottlenecks and propose clear solutions before they become problems.

  • Hit deadlines consistently without letting quality slip.


Social and performance awareness



  • Stay close to what is working on social right now, including trends, pacing, formats, and editing language.

  • Make creative decisions with performance and aesthetics in mind.

  • Use basic performance signals to inform how you cut, structure and hook content over time.


AI and workflow acceleration



  • Keep up with emerging tools that can speed up production, like transcription, captioning, audio cleanup, and smart cutdowns.

  • Adopt tools when useful, while keeping final output polished and human.


You Are a Great Fit If You



  • You have 3+ years of editing experience, with a real portfolio of short‑form work.

  • You can edit video and design motion in a way that feels native to social platforms.

  • You have strong mixed media instincts, balancing video, typography, and graphics without clutter.

  • You think like a producer. You do not wait for perfect inputs, you turn rough direction into finished work.

  • You understand hook design, pacing, rhythm and retention mechanics across social formats.

  • You are fast, organized, and steady under pressure, and you can run multiple projects at once.

  • You actively consume social media and can explain why something worked, not just that it worked.

  • You communicate clearly, take feedback well and collaborate with speed and low friction.

  • You care about craft, but you care even more about impact.


Bonus If You



  • You have edited for creators, founders, agencies or brand‑led thought leadership channels.

  • You have worked on performance creative and can connect edits to outcomes.

  • You have experience capturing and editing event content for social distribution.

  • You have built repeatable motion systems or template libraries.

  • You have explored AI tools for editing, motion, or production automation.


What It’s Like To Work At Darkroom


We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:



  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.


Job Details



  • Seniority level: Mid‑senior level

  • Employment type: Full‑time

  • Job function: Marketing, Public Relations, and Writing/Editing

  • Industries: Advertising Services

title: Art Lead - NFL Universe Football
description:
Art Lead - NFL Universe Football

Join to apply for the Art Lead - NFL Universe Football role at Voldex.

Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox’s top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 145 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 75+ full‑time remote team members across the globe.

Our top games include:

  • Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform
  • Driving Empire, the #1 driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers
  • NFL Universe Football, the #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox

Responsibilities

  • Contribute a consistent allocation of time to building out 3D art assets for the game
  • Address artistic challenges, manage art‑team workloads, and ensure art assets are delivered on time, efficiently, and within the technical performance budget
  • Lead, manage, and mentor a small team of artists, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and fostering a positive, creative work environment
  • Lead game’s style and art direction
  • Supervise both 2D, 3D, and render artists
  • Develop and maintain art‑production pipelines, processes, and documentation to ensure efficient asset creation and implementation
  • Review and provide feedback on the team’s work, ensuring assets meet quality standards and align with the artistic vision and technical requirements of the project

Requirements

  • A deep understanding of asset performance metrics and methodologies on the Roblox platform
  • High proficiency in Roblox Studio and substantial experience on the Roblox platform
  • 1‑3 years of experience working in a professional studio environment or a mixture of Roblox creator experience that demonstrates equivalent expertise and leadership
  • Highly organized and process oriented, needs to be able to think in scale and systems to help level up the Art team

Nice to Have

  • Experience creating art assets under performance constraints while maintaining a clear, visually appealing style
  • Experience collaborating with game designers and product teams to understand art request details and flag risks or needs for additional information
  • Proven ability to own a game’s art direction and mentor a team of artists toward a consistent execution of that style or direction
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage and mentor a diverse team of artists
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Monday.com, Asana, JIRA, or similar applications
  • Familiar with or a fan of American Football

Tech Stack

  • Roblox Studio
  • Photoshop / GIMP / Substance Painter
  • Maya
  • Blender

Location

  • Remote
  • Travel - 2 to 3x / year (onboarding, RDC + possible team meet‑ups)
  • Time Zone – must be willing to work EST/PST hours
  • Ideal Hiring Regions: Canada, UK, LATAM

Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation – above‑market salary + profit sharing + stock options
  • Retirement benefits – company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA!
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits – depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA.
  • Flexible PTO – vacations + Federal / Bank Holidays
  • Remote First – we have always been remote and will remain that way including work from home/anywhere
  • In‑person get‑togethers, virtual company‑wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more!
  • Professional Development – reimburse the costs of courses, materials, and anything to help further your training and growth
  • Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

Additional Information

  • Voldex Acquires Brookhaven, most visited game on Roblox
  • Driving Empire & Nascar: Brand Partnership
  • Voldex & NFL: Brand Partnership
  • Our partners at Andreessen Horowitz share why they’ve invested in Voldex

Background



  • The Assistant Maintenance Supervisor will exhibit good, supervisory and safety behaviors and will specifically ensure that all aspects of Engine Room operation or aft machinery space and maintenance are carried out safely, through careful delegation and control of responsibilities.


Authority



  • The Assistant Maintenance Supervisor is specifically responsible for the operation and maintenance of Engine Room / AMS equipment and Process utility systems controlled by the Engine Room and for the guidance and familiarization of those under their immediate supervision.


Immediate Subordinates
