  • Engine Room Equipment and Systems and Utilities Operation and Maintenance

  • Prepare Engine Room or AMS and Utility Systems for start‑up.

  • Start and Monitor Engine Room or AMS and Utility Systems.

  • Prepare and Shutdown Engine Room or AMS and Utility Systems.

  • Isolate and reinstate Engine Room or AMS and Utility Systems for Maintenance.

  • Manage and Supervise Effectively

  • Establish effective relationships with colleagues and subcontractors.

  • Implement scope of work clearly (briefings, toolbox talks, presentations).

  • Plan and control use of resources effectively. (Personnel, time, materials, transport, IT) within limit of responsibility.

  • Use of communication skills shows leadership (oral, teambuilding, recording, noting, handover, analyzing).

  • Promote training and competency assurance throughout the department in line with Company goals for the Unit.

  • Encourage and support all department personnel to achieve training and competency targets and plan for appropriate time allocation for this area of work.

  • Contribute to control of critical situations and respond to emergencies

  • Developing critical situations (operational, weather, equipment failure, leaks, fires, personnel etc.) are identified and logged for later analysis.

  • Positive action is taken to limit escalation and to maintain control using applied policies or procedures or initiative.

  • Supervisor/CCR/OIM are alerted in good time as appropriate.

  • Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures

  • Sample and check that controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits.

  • Identify and halt unplanned discharges where possible, and reported immediately according to policy, procedure and regulation.

  • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.

  • Resources such as PPE materials tools and spares are not wasted or used inefficiently.

  • Emergency Response

  • Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).

  • Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

  • Offshore - Handover

  • Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding

  • Offshore - Planning Work

  • Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment

  • Offshore - Safety Management - HOD

  • Offshore - Condition Monitoring


Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience



  • Qualified to EOOW STCW Reg AIII/1.

  • Experience as Watch keeping Marine Engineer (steam turbine watch keeping experience preferable).

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Programa Pertencer – Gerdau

A Gerdau está sempre em busca de formas de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro. Por isso, em parceria com a Firjan e com certificação do SENAI, desenvolvemos o Programa Pertencer , uma iniciativa de capacitação profissional voltada exclusivamente para mulheres e pessoas com deficiência.

Para nós, “Pertencer” significa mais do que estar em um lugar onde a diversidade é respeitada, é também perceber que ela é, de fato, valorizada.

Objetivo do programa

O objetivo do programa é capacitar mulheres e pessoas com deficiência interessadas em ingressar no ambiente industrial da empresa . Essa é uma porta de entrada para a companhia e visa habilitar novos profissionais para atuar na indústria, não sendo exigida experiência prévia .

Público-alvo:

  • Pessoas com deficiência;
  • A partir de 18 anos;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Preferencialmente residentes da Zona Oeste do RJ, Itaguaí ou Seropédica , nas proximidades da Usina Cosigua .

Local:

Usina Cosigua – Rio de Janeiro/RJ

✨ O que buscamos:

  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver;
  • Senso de resolução de problemas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação;
  • Proatividade, espírito colaborativo e autonomia.

O que oferecemos:

  • Assistência médica SULAMERICA ou UNIMED Nacional (sem carência);
  • Pronto atendimento virtual Hospital Albert Einstein;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Refeição na empresa;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Transporte fretado;
  • Benefício farmácia, fisioterapia e dentista;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Estacionamento no local;
  • Programa +Cuidado (apoio psicológico e social).

Etapas do processo seletivo:

  • Triagem dos requisitos;
  • Entrevista inicial;
  • Dinâmica de grupo;
  • Entrevista com a Área de Pessoas e líder da área operacional;
  • Visita à área;
  • Exames admissionais;
  • Entrega da documentação;
  • Admissão.

DIVERSIDADE É O QUE NOS MOVE.

Para nós, a diversidade e a inclusão são valores fundamentais . Entendemos que pessoas, independentemente da idade, características físicas ou individuais, devem se sentir seguras e representar na Gerdau o extrato real da sociedade.

Seguiremos valorizando a diversidade e promovendo a inclusão , buscando de forma intencional a participação de mulheres e pessoas com deficiência para desenvolver novos talentos e aumentar a equidade na Gerdau.

Na Gerdau, diversidade e inclusão são compromissos reais . Todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas, sem distinção de gênero, idade, raça, religião, orientação sexual, nacionalidade ou deficiência .

Se interessou? Participe do Programa Pertencer e construa seu futuro com a gente!

Temos como princípio a promoção de um ambiente diverso e inclusivo. Respeitamos e valorizamos a diversidade, por isso todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas sem distinção de deficiência, gênero, idade, identidade ou orientação sexual, nacionalidade, raça, religião, ou qualquer outra característica.

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Custos Pleno para atuar de forma estratégica na gestão dos custos logísticos da companhia. Essa posição será responsável por garantir visibilidade, precisão, eficiência e governança sobre todos os gastos relacionados à área de Logística.

Responsabilidade principal da vaga

  • Controlar, analisar e consolidar os custos logísticos (OPEX e CAPEX) de ponta a ponta, abrangendo transporte marítimo, transporte aéreo, logística de pessoas, combustíveis, bases operacionais, operações de apoio e logística terrestre.

Demais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar custos e performance das operações logísticas, garantindo aderência a contratos, premissas orçamentárias e padrões regulatórios.
  • Planejar e controlar a demanda de serviços logísticos, alinhando necessidades operacionais com fornecedores e requisitos internos.
  • Apoiar a construção e revisão do orçamento logístico, com análise crítica de variações e premissas.
  • Atuar em projetos de tecnologia aplicados à logística, como implantação ou melhoria de sistemas de gestão, planejamento e rastreamento.
  • Desenvolver análises e iniciativas de redução de custos, buscando alternativas de mercado, otimização operacional e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Superior Completa.
  • Experiência com análise e controle de custos, preferencialmente em logística.
  • Inglês intermediário é diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de SAP e Power BI avançado.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Social Investment Senior Advisor
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group: Corporate Relations

Worker Type: Regular

Posting Start Date: December 9, 2025

Business Unit: CoS and Corporate Relations

Experience Level: Experienced Professionals

What’s the role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment. You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact-led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner Mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Social Investment Senior Advisor

Join to apply for the Social Investment Senior Advisor role at Shell.

What’s The Role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment.

You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact‑led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What You Bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What We Offer

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell in Brazil

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer‑focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell‑branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

Overview

We are seeking a Network Engineer to join the Upstream Computer Operations Department.

The Upstream Computer Operations Department is responsible for supporting the network infrastructure across two main upstream data centers, two disaster recovery sites, and 14 user buildings. The scope includes configuring and managing access, distribution switches, and core routers, as well as security infrastructure such as firewalls, NAC, and IDPS, and providing support for load balancers and critical network services like DNS and DHCP.

Your primary role is to support the Upstream Digital Center (UDC) network infrastructure and services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operating and maintaining the UDC network infrastructure, including data center networks, user building networks, and DR site networks.
  • Troubleshooting and resolving complex network issues using tools like Wireshark, tcpdump, and network simulators.
  • Developing and implementing network automation scripts and workflows using tools like Ansible, Python, and Terraform.
  • Ensuring the stability, security, and performance of all network systems, including cloud-based services and DR sites.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Developing and maintaining technical documentation and diagrams of network systems, including data center networks, user building networks, and DR site networks.
  • Staying up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, and making recommendations for network upgrades and improvements.
  • Conducting proof of concepts (POCs) for new technologies in network, security, and cloud services.
  • Participating in on-call rotations and providing 24/7 support as required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Communication Engineering, or Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • 10+ years of experience in network engineering and architecture on carrier IP networks with hands‑on routing, switching, and load balancing experience in a cloud provider environment.
  • 7+ years of experience in IP networks (running Ethernet, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, Layer 2 Switching, VRFs, etc.).
  • 7+ years of experience troubleshooting and resolving complex routing and switching problems in an IP‑based carrier network.
  • Experience with Linux and excellent knowledge of core network services (DNS, SMTP, NTP, syslog, HTTP).
  • Experience with programming Python or shell scripting, especially as it relates to SDN.
  • Expert‑level knowledge in routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPBGP, MPLS).
  • Strong knowledge of IPv6, multicast, QoS, IP fast rerouting, IPSec VPN, DMVPN, and VPLS.
  • Strong knowledge in network security and enterprise security, such as DDOS, firewall, IPS, malware detection, etc.
  • Experience in designing internet backbone networks including a solid understanding of best practices, scalability strategy, and managed security services.
  • Knowledge of SDN, NFV, and SD‑WAN.
  • Preferred certifications: Cisco or Juniper ‘E’ level, additional security and VoIP certifications, CCNP, CCIE, JNCIS, JNCIP, JNCIE.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. We invest heavily in talent development, offering extensive programmes to improve sector‑specific knowledge and competencies.

Aramco energizes the world economy. With a significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce while enhancing Aramco’s value to society.

  • Atuar em conformidade com normas de segurança do trabalho e procedimentos internos da empresa.

Experiência Prática Comprovada Em:

Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Atualmente a nossa Cultura passa por um processo de transformação e evolução. Nos orgulhamos da nossa capacidade de realização e paixão que nos trouxeram até aqui e para continuarmos a evoluir juntos te convidamos a fazer parte também dessa jornada. Prazer, somos a Ambev e adoraríamos te ter com a gente. Vamos juntos?!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos formando o nosso Banco de Talentos para Supervisão de Lojas Próprias no Zé Delivery!

Se você é uma pessoa que gosta de liderar times, garantir eficiência operacional e busca constantemente a excelência nos processos, essa é a sua oportunidade de ficar no nosso radar para futuras posições na área de Operações DTC.

Aqui, valorizamos quem é mão na massa, tem perfil de dono(a) e gosta de construir resultados com propósito. Ao se inscrever, seu perfil ficará registrado para futuras oportunidades alinhadas ao escopo de Supervisão de Lojas Próprias e Operações de Campo no Zé Delivery.

Sobre a Área de Operações

O Time de Operações é o responsável por organizar o ecossistema e garantir que o cliente seja atendido sempre com excelência. E para fazer a conexão desta área com a necessidade do cliente, existem as equipes regionais que fazem a gestão dos pontos de vendas, e desenvolvem a melhor forma de aplicar o planejamento com a visão local. Como Supervisor de Lojas Próprias, você será responsável por:

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança e boas práticas operacionais;
  • Realizar o controle de estoque (inventário, contagens e conciliações)
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de nível de serviço (KPI’s), propondo planos de ação;
  • Liderar e desenvolver o time local, garantindo engajamento e performance.
  • Gerir os parceiros logísticos e garantir o desempenho das operações de entrega;
  • Garantir os processos de loja (5S, paletização e ressuprimento)
  • Realizar a gestão de despesas, custos e receitas
  • Garantir a manutenção das lojas

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e/ou liderança de operações;
  • Excel avançado, Power Point;
  • Conhecimento sobre processos logísticos, especialmente em armazém e controle de estoque;
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultados;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal, alta energia e resiliência
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial: segunda a sexta (09h às 18h) e sábado (08h às 13h).

Modelo de Trabalho

PRESENCIAL - RIO DE JANEIRO/RJ

Diferenciais

  • Saúde mental com a Telemedicina Dasa e Gente 360

Além de sonhar, se desenvolver, construir e crescer dentro de um ambiente meritocrático e inclusivo e ser capaz de fazer a diferença unindo as pessoas por um mundo melhor!

Seja bem‑vindo à Ambev.

Somos milhares de apaixonados e apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. Temos um orgulho imenso do nosso poder de impacto positivo e reconhecemos que, agindo como donos e donas, cada um de nós desempenha um papel fundamental no sucesso do nosso ecossistema. About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness.

We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Get to Know our Team

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Spearhead the development, execution, and optimization strategy for growing Agoda’s new & emerging marketing channels
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.g., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data-driven decisions for channel growth
  • Partner closely with various business functions to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 4-6 years of experience in Data Analyst position in tech, consulting, e-commerce or digital marketing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Data-Driven Approach: Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations.
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Stakeholder management & communication: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
